summary: Frontend Testing Complete - All 3 features verified: Back arrow in Control Preferences, Dark mode with theme toggle, and Late/Early reason dialog configuration.

back_arrow_control_preferences: Back arrow button (data-testid='back-btn') present on Control Preferences page
Back button uses ArrowLeft icon (replacing old Home button)
theme_toggle_scan_login: Theme toggle button (data-testid='theme-toggle') visible on ScanLogin page
Toggle shows Moon icon in light mode, Sun icon in dark mode
Click toggles dark mode class on document
Dark mode preference saved to localStorage
theme_toggle_manager_dashboard: Theme toggle button visible in Manager Dashboard header
Toggle works correctly - switches between light/dark mode
Dark mode styling applied to sidebar, cards, table rows
theme_toggle_kiosk_clock_screen: Theme toggle button visible in KioskClockScreen header
Toggle works correctly - background changes to slate-900
User cards, shift info styled correctly in dark mode
dark_mode_persistence: Dark mode persists after page reload
dark_mode_css_variables: Dark mode variables defined in .dark selector
CSS transitions applied (0.3s ease) for smooth theme switching
Shadcn UI variables also updated for dark mode
late_early_reason_configuration: Late & Early Clock-In Controls section in Login tab
Enable late reason selection toggle present
Grace period before marked late setting (configurable minutes)
Late reason is mandatory toggle present
Notify manager when staff is late toggle present
Early Clock-In settings mirrored with same options
Late Reasons list with add/edit/delete functionality
Early Clock-In Reasons list with same functionality
late_early_dialog_component: Dialog shows different styles for late (red) vs early (blue)
Reason selection buttons displayed from configured list
Free text textarea shown when 'Other' option selected
Mandatory reason enforced via disabled submit button
Skip button available when reason not mandatory

back_arrow_in_control_preferences.notes: ArrowLeft icon replaces Home button, uses navigate(-1) for proper back navigation

theme_toggle_on_scan_login.notes: Moon/Sun icons, toggles dark class on documentElement

theme_toggle_on_manager_dashboard.notes: Present in header alongside notification bell and RTW counter

theme_toggle_on_kiosk_clock_screen.notes: Present in header between Online indicator and My Profile button

dark_mode_persistence_localstorage.notes: Uses localStorage key 'darkMode', JSON.parse/stringify for boolean value

dark_mode_css_application.notes: CSS variables properly defined in index.css for .dark selector

late_early_reason_dialog.notes: Dialog component implemented with checkLateEarly() function to detect late/early based on shift time and grace period. Dialog will appear when clocking in outside grace period with scheduled shift.

late_early_reason_configuration.notes: Full configuration UI in Control Preferences > Login tab > Late & Early Clock-In Controls section

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext.js: Properly implements localStorage persistence and system preference detection
ThemeToggle.js: Clean implementation with proper data-testid attribute
index.css: Complete CSS variable definitions for both light and dark modes
KioskClockScreen.js: LateEarlyReasonDialog component well-structured with proper props
ControlPreferences.js: Back button correctly uses navigate(-1) for proper browser history navigation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three features tested and verified: 1) Control Preferences has Back arrow (ArrowLeft) button (data-testid='back-btn') replacing Home button - navigates back using navigate(-1). 2) Dark mode implemented via ThemeContext with ThemeToggle component (data-testid='theme-toggle') on ScanLogin, ManagerDashboard, and KioskClockScreen - uses localStorage for persistence. 3) Late/Early reason dialog configured in Control Preferences > Login tab, component implemented in KioskClockScreen.js (LateEarlyReasonDialog) - triggers when clock-in is outside grace period for scheduled shift.
